blockedReasons.summary: No reviewed context-window size, budget source, or runtime evidence exists.
No reviewed tokenizer, token counter, or token redaction boundary exists.
Prompt capture remains disabled by the composer and send-result boundaries.
No reviewed transcript/session-store read boundary exists.
No reviewed summary generation, summary read, or summary storage boundary exists.
Runtime context handoff is blocked until model-load and runtime execution evidence exist.

contextControls.label: review context policy
contextControls.launcherAction: Render deterministic metadata from checked fixtures only.
contextControls.userAction: Review checked context-policy metadata in the future chat UI.

contextControls.label: measure prompt tokens
contextControls.launcherAction: Do not read prompts or invoke a tokenizer.
contextControls.userAction: Measure prompt tokens only after tokenizer and prompt-read boundaries are reviewed.

contextControls.label: read transcript context
contextControls.launcherAction: Do not read transcript, message, summary, or session-store data.
contextControls.userAction: Use transcript history only after a reviewed session-store and transcript boundary exists.

contextControls.label: truncate context
contextControls.launcherAction: Do not truncate, mutate, or persist context data.
contextControls.userAction: Apply truncation only after context-budget and redaction rules are reviewed.

contextControls.label: generate context summary
contextControls.launcherAction: Do not generate or read summaries.
contextControls.userAction: Generate summaries only after explicit summary and storage boundaries are reviewed.

contextControls.label: handoff runtime context
contextControls.launcherAction: Keep runtime handoff blocked and do not start model execution.
contextControls.userAction: Send context to a runtime only after model-load and runtime evidence are reviewed.

contextPolicy.contentPolicy: context metadata only; no prompt, response, transcript, summary, token text, token count, model path, tokenizer path, runtime log, or private path is included

contextSlots.contentPolicy: no context size, token budget, path, or runtime evidence value is included
contextSlots.label: model context window
contextSlots.sourcePolicy: checked target label only; no model descriptor, runtime, config, model path, tokenizer, or asset file is read

contextSlots.contentPolicy: no prompt content, prompt length, token text, token count, or derived summary is included
contextSlots.label: prompt draft
contextSlots.sourcePolicy: composer boundary remains disabled and does not capture prompt text

contextSlots.contentPolicy: no transcript message bodies, summaries, token counts, or history metadata are included
contextSlots.label: transcript history
contextSlots.sourcePolicy: transcript and session-store reads are disabled

contextSlots.contentPolicy: no summary text, transcript-derived metadata, or generated content is included
contextSlots.label: generated summary
contextSlots.sourcePolicy: summary generation and summary reads are unavailable

contextSlots.contentPolicy: no assembled prompt, serialized context, tokenized context, or runtime payload is included
contextSlots.label: assembled runtime context
contextSlots.sourcePolicy: context assembly is blocked until prompt, transcript, tokenizer, and runtime handoff boundaries are reviewed

handoffRefs.summary: Composer metadata keeps prompt capture and send controls blocked.
Transcript policy keeps retention, export, and content access disabled.
Message-list metadata keeps the viewport empty and message bodies absent.
Model status keeps runtime, context, and response rows blocked.

limitations: Data-only chat context-policy fixture; context windows, budgets, tokenization, summaries, and runtime handoff remain disabled.
No prompt, response, transcript, message body, summary, session store, configuration file, environment value, model path, tokenizer path, runtime log, private path, secret, or token is read.
No token count, context-window size, token budget, transcript history, summary text, or runtime payload is included.

No prompt capture, transcript read, token counting, context truncation, context assembly, summary generation, model load, model execution, runtime handoff, telemetry, upload, or artifact write is performed.
No KV260 hardware access, pccx-lab invocation, or systemverilog-ide invocation is performed.
This is not a release, tag, compatibility commitment, marketplace flow, storage layer, tokenizer implementation, context manager, runtime, model-loader, or hardware implementation.
